mods.name: Centered Flora
mods.description: Disables random model offsets for plants, keeping flowers, grass, saplings, crops, and other vegetation perfectly centered.

releases.notes:
## Initial Release

Centered Flora removes Minecraft's random model offsets, keeping flowers, grass, saplings, crops, and other vegetation perfectly centered for a cleaner and more consistent look.

### Compatibility
- Minecraft: 26.1 – 26.3 (tested; newer 26.x versions may work)
- Fabric Loader: 0.19.5 or newer
- Java: 25 or newer

### Features
- Removes random model offsets from supported vegetation.
- Client-side only.
